candidates.title: Persist self-improvement state atomically
candidates.problem: saveState() writes directly to state.json. An interrupted write can leave truncated JSON, causing loadState() to fail and preventing subsequent daily runs from starting.
candidates.solution: Write the complete state to a same-directory temporary file, sync it, atomically rename it over state.json, and clean up temporary files after failures.
benefits: Preserves the previous valid state until replacement succeeds.
Prevents interrupted writes from disabling future runs.
Eliminates manual recovery from truncated state files.
verification: Add a filesystem test proving failure before rename preserves the previous state.
Add a test proving a successful atomic write replaces and reloads the state.
candidates.risk: Low; the change is confined to local runner state persistence.
